description: Update an annotation's text, tags, color, or visibility. Only annotations people added (source databuddy); GitHub markers are read-only. confirmed=false (default) returns the changes without writing; confirmed=true applies them.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

isPublic.description: true also shows the annotation on the website's public dashboard; false shows it only to organization members.

tags.description: Replaces the saved tags; omit to keep them, or pass [] to clear them.

name: update_annotation

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. annotation contains its text, type, time coordinates, tags, color, public visibility and source with its GitHub link; saved results also include ID and update time; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Update annotation
